current.series_title: 10 Ways to Get Rich Fast in GTA 6
current.topic: fastest money making methods in GTA 6

tips.caption: Large bank vaults pay the most
tips.narration: Late game, there are eight big vaults. Guides report up to two hundred grand in about five minutes. Nothing else comes close.

tips.caption: Rob criminals while they're mid-job
tips.narration: Let another crew do the hard part, then take their bags. Bring both of you to carry more. Their heat becomes yours, though.
tips.footage: ambushing a crew outside a jewelry store

tips.caption: Pick jewelry stores with diamond icons
tips.narration: Diamond icons beat ring icons. Same risk, bigger take. Reported at ten to twenty-five grand a store.

tips.caption: Sleep to reset the Pay 'n' Spray limit
tips.narration: Shops stop buying after three or four cars a day. Go to bed, wake up, sell again. Easiest early money there is.

tips.caption: Scan a car's value before you steal it
tips.narration: Point the WAiNK app at a car first. It shows value and security. Don't risk a chase for a junker.

tips.caption: You can rob almost any store
tips.narration: Map icons are just suggestions. Walk into nearly any shop, take the register and the safe, and do it again later.

tips.caption: Safe early cash from treasure dives
tips.narration: Kenton pays cash for wrecks in the Keys. First couple dives net a few grand, and nobody's shooting at you. Rare luxury.

tips.caption: Watch for random-event loot
tips.narration: Exploding boats at sea drop packages worth a couple grand. Keep your eyes open while you drive. Free money floats.

tips.caption: Win the demolition derby for legal money
tips.narration: Ambrosia Raceway pays reportedly up to six grand a win. No cops, no stars. Just wreck everyone. My kind of job.

tips.caption: Deposit cash after every big job
tips.narration: Cash in your pocket can disappear. Hit an ATM after every big score. Trust me, I learned the hard way.
tips.footage: walking to an ATM after a heist
